 Starbucks Singapore’s Pompompurin + Starbucks® collection arrives in stores, on the Starbucks Online Store and on LazMall from Tuesday, 10 November 2026 . The piece worth planning a coffee run around is a $9.90 blind bag that you can only add on with a purchase. Starbucks says it and Sanrio’s beret-wearing golden retriever are both celebrating their 30th anniversaries, so this Singapore-exclusive drop is a birthday party with two guests of honour.
 Pompompurin’s appeal is easy to explain: a laidback golden retriever in a signature brown beret . Here, Starbucks has redrawn him with designs inspired by its own drinks and coffee moments. There are eight merchandise pieces , a three-design lanyard blind bag and, from 12 November, a free straw clip set for delivery orders, so you can dip in as lightly or as deeply as your wallet allows.
 Two 30th Anniversaries, One Beret
 What sets this one apart is that Pompompurin gets to share the cake. Starbucks says he is marking his 30th anniversary too, which gives the whole thing a nice same-batch energy for anyone who grew up with him.
 The $9.90 Lucky Dip
 A blind bag is a sealed pack that hides which design you’re getting until you open it. The Phone Lanyard with Charms Blind Bag costs $9.90 , and that price comes with one condition: you can only buy it with any purchase . Starbucks says there are three collectible designs , and each one pairs a Pompompurin character with a Starbucks-inspired beverage charm.
 The three Pompompurin + Starbucks phone lanyards come in cream, mint and brown, each with a Pompompurin charm and a coffee-themed patch The detail that makes this more forgiving than most blind bags is that the charms are detachable . Starbucks says they can be used separately or together, so fans can mix and match their favourite designs. Pull a double and the spare charm still has somewhere to go, which takes some of the sting out of chasing the full set of three.
 Plan for where you’ll buy it, because the blind bag is sold in stores and on the Starbucks Online Store only . It won’t be on LazMall. It’s capped at six pieces per customer , while stocks last, so a full-set hunt is possible if luck is on your side.
 Eight Pieces, Three Worth Chasing
 The main collection runs to eight items: the Plush , Furry Pouch , Reusable Bag with Canvas Pouch , Plush Keychain , 12oz Ceramic Mug , 20oz Stainless Steel Tumbler , 16oz Glass Cold Cup and Ceramic Plate Set . Starbucks pitches the range for everyday use, gifting and collecting during the year-end season. That’s a fair way to sort it before you queue.
 A frosted bottle covered in Pompompurin drink doodles sits next to a plush Pompompurin pouch stuffed with makeup and accessories For collectors, the Plush is the obvious anchor, since it’s the purest form of a character who made his name being soft and cuddly. For daily use, the 16oz Glass Cold Cup is the pick, because the collection’s designs draw on Starbucks drinks and an iced latte is the natural place to show them off.
 For gifting, the Ceramic Plate Set stands out. It’s the most grown-up thing in the range and works for the friend who outgrew plushies but never outgrew Pompompurin. With Christmas parties on the calendar, a plate set feels like a present with real use beyond a shelf.
 The Ceramic Plate Set pairs a green embossed plate with a yellow Pompompurin-face plate, laid out here with croissants and a latte The purchase cap is generous: six pieces per item per customer . It leaves room to buy for your friends, your siblings and the colleague who keeps a Sanrio shrine on their desk.
 Free Straw Clips for the Sofa Crowd
 If you’d rather stay home, there’s a separate perk from Thursday, 12 November . Spend at least $25 on a delivery order via Starbucks Delivers, GrabFood or foodpanda and you’ll get a free Pompompurin + Starbucks® Straw Clip Set .
 The Pompompurin + Starbucks reusable bag, printed with the golden retriever clutching coffees and pastries, is one of eight pieces in the collection One catch matters here. The $25 is a net spend after Stars redemption and vouchers . Your order has to clear $25 after those deductions, not before. The freebie is limited to one per qualifying transaction , it’s valid on delivery orders only, and it runs while stocks last.
 Plan Your Run
 Timing depends on where you shop. Stores carry the collection from 10 November , the Starbucks Online Store opens it at 10am , and LazMall follows at 12pm . Everything is sold while stocks last. If the blind bag is your main target, a store or the Starbucks Online Store is the place to be, since that’s where you’ll find both the lanyards and the main range.
 🗓️ Date: From Tuesday, 10 November 2026, while stocks last
⏰ Time: 10am on the Starbucks Online Store; 12pm on LazMall
📍 Location: Starbucks stores in Singapore, the Starbucks Online Store and Starbucks on LazMall
🧸 Collection: Plush, Furry Pouch, Reusable Bag with Canvas Pouch, Plush Keychain, 12oz Ceramic Mug, 20oz Stainless Steel Tumbler, 16oz Glass Cold Cup and Ceramic Plate Set
🎁 Blind Bag: Phone Lanyard with Charms Blind Bag, $9.90 with any purchase; three designs; in stores and on the Starbucks Online Store only; up to six per customer
🛒 Purchase Limit: Six pieces per item per customer
🥤 Delivery Freebie: From Thursday, 12 November 2026, a free Straw Clip Set with a $25 net spend after Stars and vouchers via Starbucks Delivers, GrabFood or foodpanda; one per qualifying transaction
 Thirty years is a long time to love a pudding-coloured dog in a beret, and this collection rewards that loyalty with a blind bag hunt. Set an alarm for 10 November . Browse the range on the Starbucks Online Store from 10am, or head to Starbucks on LazMall at noon. You can follow @starbuckssg on Instagram for weekly launches and member exclusives, and may your first blind bag be the design you were hoping for!
 Photos and Visuals courtesy of Starbucks Singapore.
